name: Ahè
text: Ahè is a variant form of the name Dahut. That figure appears as villainess in the Breton legend of Ys, the city drowned beneath the sea. Ahè and Dahut name one selfish person. The legend tells how Ys sank.

attributes.attribute: a variant form of the name Dahut
tied to the legend of the submerged city of Ys
